items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: We spent weeks with auditions at Carol's studio and we got Harvey Estrom there and Al Block and Ray Sheiner, Wally King--God bless Wally, Gene Allen; good players.

ctx.x: That was the road band. We spent weeks with auditions at Carol's studio and we got Harvey Estrom

there and Al Block and Ray Sheiner, Wally King--God bless Wally, Gene Allen; good players. Sonny Russo--we almost didn't get Sonny. Tommy Mitchell wanted to come as a B flat trombonist, wound up being one of the best bass trombonists in the country.
Nick came on the road with us, Bobby did; Joe couldn't--didn't want to, so we had Al Majorca (phonetic spelling) then.
